name: dsh-test-live
description: Host-wide live test log panel for DeepSeek Harness: every conversation's test runs in one sidebar list, streamed line by line over SSE with a per-run summary. A run belongs to the conversation that started it and runs in that conversation's directory; finished runs are kept in a shared state file. Runners are descriptor-driven (go test, vitest, jest, node --test, pytest, a gated package.json script, or a custom command), auto-detected from the project, each with its own output grammar and counters.
